experiment_template.research_question: Does a second bounded fully accounted correction convert repeated length responses into completed trajectories within the unchanged total-token cap?
stop_conditions: No favorable rerun or task replacement.
No task, state, order, context, output cap, total-token cap, threshold or scorer change.
Only bounded incomplete-output handling and the common correction limit may change.

records.falsifier: The two-length-then-success oracle does not complete exactly once, a third length response is dispatched after two corrections, any failed token disappears, an uncertain request is retried, context or total-token admission is relaxed, or live branches still fail at the same repeated-length boundary.
records.mechanism: Handle incomplete output in a bounded loop. Only an HTTP 200 response with valid usage and finish_reason length becomes recoverable. Persist each failed receipt, acknowledge it without replay, and make the second feedback demand one minimal tool call or terminal submission. Stop after two corrections.
records.scope: GLM-5.3-flash exposed 8K ContextBench development tasks; useful reasoning-state continuity after actual recycling, with the fixed acceptance target and cumulative model input plus output tokens.
records.statement: Allowing at most two fully accounted concise-action corrections will recover repeated GLM-5.3-flash length responses at 8K more often than the one-correction policy while preserving the fixed context and cumulative model input plus output token caps.

records.claim: H27 passed both offline oracles and one live state branch survived two consecutive fully accounted length responses and completed. Task 1 completed all three pairs with mean span F1 delta +0.2028, but Round 17 later stopped on a separate single-attempt request-tokenizer transport failure.
limitations: H27 support does not establish H25, transfer, correctness or clearance.
One of task 1 three span deltas was negative.

records.next_action: Preserve Round 17. Apply the existing identical-body, zero-model-token retry rule to the full-request tokenizer path, prove cross-path parity offline, then freeze a policy-v4-bound Round 18 with all semantic variables unchanged.
